title: Move and jump
hints: direction: x = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0), the same for y, then divide both by Math.hypot(x, y) when that is not 0.
movePlayer: use direction(keys), and clamp x between 0 and bounds.width - player.w with Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max).
jump: copy the body first. Step 1 only sets vy and onGround. Step 2 runs when it is not on the ground, in the same call.
